item.title: Hello, I'm new
item.description: Hello, I’m new here so I thought I’d just say hi. I’m not a graphic designer or typographer or anything like that… I just really like finding and enjoying new fonts. It seems like I found a great forum to talk to others who also enjoy this as well as meet some designers who are using new and different fonts in their projects, as well as meet some designers who are actually making new fonts themselves!
